series_label: Maternal mortality ratio (number of maternal deaths per 100,000 live births)
source_or_custodian: United Nations Maternal Mortality Estimation Interagency Group (DATA_SOURCE field of the server record)
release_or_vintage: United Nations Maternal Mortality Estimation Interagency Group 2025
status_or_notes: Observation status 'Modelled' for every year; observation confidentiality 'Free'; SERIES_FOOTNOTE and OBS_FOOTNOTE empty; LOWER_BOUND and UPPER_BOUND empty for all years, so no uncertainty intervals were returned. Values for 2024 and 2025 are not in the server response (the series ends at 2023), so they are omitted rather than filled. Geographic area Nigeria, sex Total, age Total, all disaggregations Total. The same indicator is also listed for flow UNICEF/CME/1.0 but a query there for NGA returned HTTP 404, so the MNCH flow is the one that returned data. The SDG 3.1.1 candidates (SH_STA_MMR in UNICEF/CHILD_RELATED_SDG/1.0, C030101 in UNICEF/SDG_PROG_ASSESSMENT/1.1) were listed by the server but their queries did not resolve, so they were not used.
definition: Maternal mortality ratio (number of maternal deaths per 100,000 live births): the server's indicator name for MNCH_MMR. No separate definition text was returned.
